item.title: Version 0.3.1
item.description:
What's New

  • Support Walasr from anywhere. Outside Indonesia, "Support" now opens Buy Me a Coffee; in Indonesia it's still QRIS. The other option is always one small link away.
  • About links to the Walasr website (walasr.my.id) and credits the prayer icons to Edo Putra.

Bug Fixes

  • The notch island is centred on a MacBook's camera notch. It could show up to the left of the notch.
  • The full-screen countdown's minimize button points up again, toward the notch it goes into.

item.title: Version 0.3.0
item.description:
Thank you to Sidiq Prihatno for redesigning every reminder in this release.

What's New

  • A new look for every reminder. Reminders, the adhan and the iqamah countdown now come out of the notch: black at the top, flowing into the colour of the prayer's sky, with a soft light along the edge. The full-screen countdown has the same look, as a glowing circle in the middle of the screen.
  • The prayer's name comes first. When a countdown starts, it shows "Time for Asr" for a moment before the numbers. At iqamah it says "Time to pray", then counts up how long it has been.
  • Close after iqamah. Choose how many minutes after iqamah the countdown closes itself, in Settings › Iqamah.
  • Count down to the adhan (optional). Turn it on in Settings › Reminders to count down to each adhan, for the prayers you choose.
  • Glass buttons in full screen. They stay hidden until you point at the countdown, so your screen stays clear.
  • Dim the screen your way. Drag the thin arc along the bottom of the notch countdown to set how dark the screen gets; it still reaches full darkness at iqamah.
  • Prayer times in the notch can show a countdown, as in the menu bar.
  • Settings reorganised: General, Location, Prayer Times, Reminders, Iqamah, Screen, Lock Mac, Menu Bar & Notch and About. On screens without a notch, choose a floating pill or an island attached to the top.

Bug Fixes

  • Walasr opens at login again. Only the copy in Applications registers itself as a login item.
  • A minimized countdown no longer stays minimized for the next prayer after your Mac was locked.
  • The schedule panel closes when you open Settings or another Walasr window.
  • Snooze never runs past iqamah. It hides the countdown for 5 minutes, or comes back for the last 10 seconds before iqamah if that's sooner, and no longer moves iqamah later. In the last minute only "I've prayed" remains.
  • The adhan isn't announced twice with the full-screen countdown.
  • Prayer times in the notch no longer block clicks on what's around them.
  • Friday labels read correctly for the Jumu'ah reminder.
  • Lower CPU use while reminders are on screen.

item.title: Version 0.2.1
item.description:
Bug Fixes

  • The iqamah countdown is back beside the prayer name. In v0.2.0 the window buttons pushed the countdown onto its own row; now the number sits on the same line as "Asr · Iqamah in" again.
  • Smaller, tidier window buttons. Dim/blur off, minimize and close are small buttons in the card's top-right corner that never move the layout. The same goes for the adhan, reminder and Friday notch, and for the full-screen countdown.
  • Full-screen countdown buttons no longer look greyed out while you're working in another app.

item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
What's New

  • Lock your Mac at iqamah (optional). Turn it on in Settings › Iqamah to lock your Mac at iqamah or a few minutes after, per prayer. A 10-second warning appears on every screen first, with Cancel (or Esc) if you need a moment. It never locks while you're sharing or presenting your screen, after you skip or close the countdown, or when you wake your Mac after iqamah has passed.
  • Close the adhan and reminder notch with the new × button.
  • Change the menu bar display from the right-click menu. Pick a format under "Menu Bar Display" without opening Settings.
  • Cleaner notch controls. Minimize and close sit in the top-right corner, apart from Snooze and I've prayed.

Bug Fixes

  • The "10 minutes left" reminder no longer shows twice.
  • The notch sits on the camera notch even when your MacBook isn't the main display.
  • Friday's countdown now says "Jumu'ah adhan in" instead of counting down to iqamah.
  • The lock warning always appears for a full 10 seconds before your Mac locks. If the warning can't be shown, Walasr skips the lock.

item.title: Version 0.1.2
item.description:
What's New

  • Works across all your displays. The full-screen countdown now appears on every screen, with its buttons on the screen your pointer is on. Reminders and the notch countdown also show a small pill on external displays. Prefer one screen? Choose "Main screen only" in Settings › Iqamah.
  • Close or shrink the notch countdown. The × button hides it for that prayer (darkening and blur too, while the menu bar keeps counting). The minimize button shrinks it to a small icon and timer; click it to open it again.
  • Set each prayer's iqamah gap during setup, so the countdown matches your nearest masjid from the start.
  • Blur is now off by default (darkening stays on). Turn it on anytime in Settings › Iqamah.

Bug Fixes

  • The screen never freezes anymore. In the last 2 minutes before iqamah the countdown used to block clicks and keyboard; now your work stays usable the whole time and only the countdown's own buttons take clicks.
  • Switching the countdown style back to Notch works during a countdown. It used to stay full screen until the next prayer.
  • The 15-second preview switches to full screen at the right moment for your "minutes before iqamah" setting, instead of always after 6 seconds.

item.title: Version 0.1.1
item.description:
What's New

  • Choose when the iqamah countdown appears. Start it right at the adhan (as before) or only a few minutes before iqamah, e.g. 5 minutes before when your mosque waits 15.
  • Switch to full screen near iqamah. The countdown can start quietly in the notch and move to full screen a few minutes before iqamah.
  • Live iqamah countdown in the menu bar, to the second, matching the one on screen.
  • "Now" status after the adhan. The menu bar and schedule panel show the current prayer and time to iqamah instead of jumping straight to the next prayer.
  • New app icon.
  • Simpler countdown styles: Notch or Full screen. If you used Window, Walasr switches you to Full screen.

Bug Fixes

  • Countdown digits roll again instead of just swapping each second.
  • Darkening and blur are smooth instead of stepping once a second.
  • The adhan notch and the iqamah countdown no longer overlap. The countdown waits until the adhan moment is done.
  • Much lower CPU use with the panel or countdown open. The night-sky panel went from about 4% to near zero.

item.title: Version 0.1.0
item.description:
What's New

  • Official prayer times in your menu bar. Kemenag RI for Indonesia (per regency/city), JAKIM for Malaysia, MUIS for Singapore, and astronomical calculation everywhere else. Times are downloaded once a month and keep working offline.
  • Iqamah countdown after every adhan. Show it in the notch, full screen or a window, and set how many minutes each prayer's iqamah gap is.
  • The screen slowly darkens and blurs until iqamah, so you stop working in time to pray. Turn either off in Settings, or for a single prayer minimize the countdown to the notch or switch off dim & blur.
  • Snooze, skip, Friday and pause. Snooze once for 5 minutes, skip when you've prayed, get a Jumu'ah reminder before Dhuhr on Fridays, and pause reminders for a few days when you need to.
  • Notch view on MacBooks. See the next prayer and its countdown beside the notch, alongside or instead of the menu bar.
  • A schedule panel that follows the sky, with a sun arc across the day, the Hijri date and the next prayer time front and center.
  • Reminders before each prayer and a soft chime when the time comes, plus a short ayah about prayer during the countdown.
  • 12- or 24-hour time, per-prayer minute corrections, Indonesian and English.
  • Free, with no account and no tracking.
